subject: Intro: [NAME] <> [SENDER]
text:
Hi [NAME],

As your data volumes and team continue to grow following your Series A, we
often see this stage as a key inflection point where teams start to feel
the need for more scalable infrastructure to support efficient model
development. Is that something you're experiencing at [COMPANY]?

I'm part of the Defence & Security team at Encord, where we've built an
end-to-end data development platform that combines data curation,
annotation, workflow management, and model observability into one
integrated solution - helping ML teams eliminate bottlenecks and accelerate
model development.

We're working with teams like Woven by Toyota, Controp, and Eurocontrol -
all of whom initially struggled with their curation & annotation tools that
lacked the speed and scalability needed to efficiently visualise and
surface edge cases from their large, multimodal datasets.

Would you be open to a 15-minute chat this or next week to dive into how we
have helped others in the space?

subject: Working with Viz.ai for AI in Imaging & Multimodal AI | [SENDER] @ Encord
text:
Hi [NAME]​,

Congrats on the recent promotion! I lead the Multimodal Medical Imaging AI team here at Encord (~6 years old, 100+ employees & $50M+ funding), actually working with a few of your peers (Optellum, Viz.ai etc) to speed up their annotation process and improve model accuracy through precise segmentation of DICOM/NIFTII/CT data (e.g. thresholding brush, tracking) built with traceability in mind. Interestingly, they were also looking at integrating other modalities (e.g. EHRs, text, audio) into their models. My team has been following AIDoc for a while and this seems to be the direction you're also taking, keen to trade notes on what I've been seeing in the Medical Imaging AI space & get your thoughts on what we're building if you're be open to a 30-minute chat this week or the next?
